title: Autonomous Trading Platform I made and need honest suggestions
author: Only-Rest-8727
selftext: Ok so i made this autonomous trading platform kind of which originally had btc on which i trained 3 machine learning model and weighted thier results to give one decision. Then recently i added altcoins as well. Now I want to commercialise this thing but I think i am just getting a little too ambitious. I want to make a platform that lets you design your strategy and monitors your trade 24/7 and you can put trailing stoploss and give market analysis and give ideal take profit position based on the analysis. I dont want to put the machine learning model in it as that need constant retraining. Also I could add already available strategies and an option to backtest the strategy you made. Now I want you guys to give me a reality check maybe or give me suggestions tbh.
